name: Pact of the Wrathful
description: Play the Pact of the Wrathful if you want to destroy those who act against you.

foundation.name: Patron’s Fury
foundation.text: Spend a Favor to imbue your attacks with your Patron’s power until you deal Severe damage or the scene ends. When you roll damage while this effect is active, you also roll a number of Patron Dice equal to your tier and add their total to the damage dealt.

foundation.name: Deadly Vengeance
foundation.text: When you mark any number of Hit Points from an attack, you can spend a Favor to roll an equal number of Patron Dice. For each result of 4 or higher, the attacker marks a Hit Point.

specialization.name: Menacing Reach
specialization.text: Spend a Favor to increase the range of your primary weapon by one step (such as Melee to Very Close or Very Close to Close) to a maximum of Very Far range. This effect ends when you make a successful attack with that weapon.

specialization.name: Diminish My Foes
specialization.text: When you succeed with Hope on an action roll against a target, you can spend any number of Favor to force the target to mark an equal number of Stress.

mastery.name: Fearsome Attack
mastery.text: Spend a Favor to reroll any number of your damage dice. You can continue spending Favor to use this feature on the same damage roll.

mastery.name: Otherworldly Ire
mastery.text: Once per rest when you take damage, you can spend any number of Favor to roll that many Patron Dice and target a number of creatures within Close range equal to the highest result. Each target must mark a Hit Point.
